evals.name: migrate-monolith-claudemd
evals.prompt: I'm starting to use Cursor too, not just Claude. I want my agent rules to work across both tools without duplicating everything. Restructure things appropriately.
evals.expected_output: Migration of the existing CLAUDE.md (which contains flat inline rules) to a hub-and-spoke layout: AGENTS.md becomes the hub, the rules move into a Spoke file, CLAUDE.md and .cursorrules are rewritten as one-line pointers to AGENTS.md.

evals.name: fresh-project
evals.prompt: Set up agent rules for this project. We use TypeScript strict mode and never commit `.env*` files. The frontend in `frontend/` uses React 19 with Server Components by default; the backend in `backend/` uses Express + Drizzle.
evals.expected_output: Fresh hub-and-spoke layout: AGENTS.md as hub with routing rules pointing at folder-specific Spokes (one for frontend, one for backend, plus a global one for the project-wide TypeScript / .env rule). CLAUDE.md is a one-line pointer.
